text:
Predicates:
IstanbulPlate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: license plate x begins with number y.
FromIstanbul(x) ::: license plate x is from Istanbul.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Plate(x) ::: x is a license plate.
Number(y) ::: y is a number.
Premises:
∀x (Plate(x) ∧ FromIstanbul(x) → BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All plates from Istanbul begin with 34.
∀x (Plate(x) ∧ ¬BeginsWith(x, 34) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not beginning with 34 are not from Istanbul.
JoePlate(x) ∧ FromIstanbul(x) ::: Joe's license plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(TomPlate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.
Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(TomPlate) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
